# Code of Conduct

We are committed to a respectful, technically rigorous, and welcoming community.

Be constructive, cite evidence, separate criticism of an implementation from criticism of a person, disclose conflicts of interest, respect privacy, and avoid harassment, discrimination, threats, or deliberate disruption.

Project maintainers may edit or remove harmful content and restrict participation when necessary to protect contributors and users. Report conduct concerns privately to the maintainers after the public repository is established.
